txt: *"All* of them did it." He puts his hand on the gun. "All of them need to die."
...and then he bellows: "For killing, maiming and humiliating our commanding officer -- you're all sentenced to death by lead!"
A look of happiness. His eyes seem unnaturally bright, shining like stars. Something in the fear must distort him somehow. He is evil. And the end.
A shadow, towering. Someone stands there -- raising his pistol at him. The lieutenant does not see it. He's pushing down on your wound with both hands...
He pulls the trigger. A plume of smoke erupts from the muzzle.
He sways from left to right, inspecting you.
He turns to his left and says: "Kill him."
It's not all dark yet. As you're leaving, *he* is in there too, with you. You can *feel* the figure move. And then a distant gunshot. Velvety smooth. Muffled.
The large man laughs. "Look around you, livestock... we're about to butcher the lot of you! Where is your *international law*?"
The leader gives a small nod to the helmeted man. Suddenly the blue medicinal spirit in your hand seems to have a pulsating glow. It feels enticing somehow...
The leader gives a small nod to the helmeted man. Suddenly the grip of your side-arm feels comforting and warm in your hand. Feels like it's saying: Do it!
The leader gives a small nod to the helmeted man. Suddenly your fingers holding the grip of a gun, that has just taken a life, tingle... Go for it, it seems to say.
The leader gives a small nod to the helmeted man. You feel your fists contract, as you stand there, between these men -- all carrying real weapons.
The look of vengeance. Framed by melting skin. This is the last thing he will do on Earth -- but he *will* do it. He will end you.
The look of vengeance. Framed in blood, lips shaking. This is the last thing he'll do on Earth -- but he *will* do it. He is your end.
The man it was supposed to hit is looking over his shoulder -- to see where it went. And he can't see it! It's THAT OFF.
The man stares at you with bloodshot eyes, a bull ready to charge -- he's not listening, but looking for an opening...
The weapon bounces off his shoulder. He turns to his left and says: "Kill him."
There is a hole in his cheek. Blood gushes out as he stumbles backward, eyes filled with rage and disbelief -- gurgling, muttering something unintelligible...
This guy? Well -- his face has *cracked open* into a scream of terror. It looks like he's performing some sort of a shamanistic dance... that requires you to be on fire?!
You hear a roar of pain. A death scream. The sound disappears, like someone pressed STOP on the tape. The hulking figure too is gone. And so is Kim. And the whole world.
You see two cold eyes looking at you -- through all the smoke and the panic. And a pistol, raised, aiming at your chest, point blank. Then the man squeezes the trigger...
You see two crazed eyes stare at you -- through all the smoke and the panic. With blood gushing from his face the man raises his pistol at you. Then he squeezes the trigger...
You see two crazed eyes stare at you -- through the burning meat and the flames. With his face boiling off the man raises his pistol at you. Then he squeezes the trigger...
"...fucking murdered him. Had him stink the village up for two weeks after. And you fucks did nothing." He points at you.
"All right." He wipes the sweat from his brow. "Let's do this. Smear your shit all over this fucking dung field..."
"Baby blue, yeah... Like someone fucked up and put a baby's eyes on a grown man." He smiles, pulling his face in a strange way.
"Didn't sound like nothing." He wipes the sweat from his brow. "Sounded like you were about to break into a sermon. Was that it?"
"Do it, primitive..." He points to his chest. "Take me out."
"Find his killer?! Cop, his killer stands right there!" He waves at the men behind you. "Shitting his pants -- and *you're* standing in the way protecting them."
"Find his killer?! Cop, his killers stand right there!" He waves at the men behind you. "Shitting their pants -- and *you're* standing in the way protecting them."
"Fuck do you mean *talker*?"
"Fucking liars..." He pulls the trigger. A plume of smoke erupts from the muzzle of his gun.
"Get lost, comedian. You cops had your chance. Now it's fucking time for some justice." He licks his lips, waving his gun at the crowd. Losing his balance for a moment, he staggers backward.
"Go ahead. Give it another try." The man doesn't even move. He’s smiling.
"Go ahead." He points his gun at Elizabeth. "Tell me about some cunt who killed herself one more time..."
"Go ahead." He points his gun at Elizabeth. "Tell me about some other cunt on the coast one more time..."
"Go ahead." He points his gun at Elizabeth. "Tell me it was the fucking cafeteria manager one more time!"
"Go ahead." He pulls the trigger. A plume of smoke erupts from the muzzle.
"HEY, BUSHMEN!!!" The veins on the man's neck expand as he yells. "Your little CUNT isn't gonna help you out of this one!"
"He likes to fire mortars at random coordinates. Wipe out mud-huts like that. When he gets *bored*. Lely knew how to command."
"He wasn't my fucking brother! We just grew up on the same farm and got beat into place by the same sick fuck..."
"Hold your fire!" He licks his lips. "Wait for my command."
"How about the kipt?" He points his gun at Elizabeth. A sudden, jerking motion. "They fucking all did it together..."
"How about the kipt?" He points his gun at Elizabeth. "Go ahead -- tell me about some *puta* one more time..."
"How about the kipt?" He points his gun at Elizabeth. "Go ahead -- tell me that confusing shit one more time..."
"How about the kipt?" He points his gun at Elizabeth. "Go ahead, tell me again how some cunt did it..."
"How about the kipt?" He points his gun at Elizabeth. "Go ahead, tell me we fucking killed our own colonel one more time..."
"How about the kipt?" He points his gun at Elizabeth. "Go ahead. Say *inadvertently* one more time..."
"How about the kipt?" He points his gun at Elizabeth. "Go ahead. Tell me about some fucking *room* again..."
"How about the kipt?" He points his gun at Elizabeth. "Tell me it was a magic fucking sniper one more time..."
"How about the kipt?" He points his gun at Elizabeth. "That'd be fucking *funny*..."
"How about the kipt?" He points his gun at Elizabeth. "They fucking all did it together..."
"How fucking *convenient*..." He gives you a drunken stare -- then puts his hand on the gun.
"Huh?" He just stares at you with his watery eyes.
"I am a Krenel major with over 15 years of live-combat experience. When my colonel gets hanged by clay-monkeys I lead the platoon on a *retaliation strike*."
"I can never tell with these Aboriginals..."
"I know what this tactic is, Silo Sam." He stares at you, eyes pink from the alcohol -- fingers tapping the pistol. "You're gonna die for them. Right here. Today."
"I missed." The man looks at his revolver and smiles.
"I'm all out of shits to give, loincloth." There's a feverish gleam in his eyes. "Welcome to the fucking reckoning."
"If I fuck and kill you, hang you to that street light..." He points to it. "... by your shit-pipes -- then that's called a *necessary display of force*."

"If Lely was here, he would spare the lot of you. Maybe shoot one for show. But me..." He points to himself. "I'm not a big fan of public affairs, clay-monkey. I'll gun every one of you down for what you did."
"Interrupt me again and I will execute you on the spot, lance-corporal." The outburst is accompanied by yellowish saliva around his mouth.
"Is she?" He pulls the trigger. A plume of smoke erupts from the muzzle.
"It was creepy, but bitches... bitches like that shit, I guess. Or... I don't know what bitches like. I just know how to mow down *cloths*."
"King Reaper," he says without irony.
"Lance-corporal..." He turns to the woman. "Just fucking shut up and wait for your order."
"Let me help you then..." The man looks to his left. "Kill him."
"Look, loincloth." He turns to you. "I'm a funny clown."
"Nah... I just have the biggest gun." He raps on his armoured barrel-like chest.
"Nah..." He wipes the sweat from his brow. "I'm clear as day. Fucking government ordained super-soldier..."
"No one's going to give a shit about dead loincloths." He snorts. "That's reality."
"Not after this shit."
"Not today, Ruud. That'll be *me* today..." He looks at the woman on the plaza floor.
"Oh yeah, he would have commanded this fuck-hell way better than I did. But that didn't happen, because Hayseed Bill and Kipty the Kipt here..." he points to Titus and Eugene.
"Oh yeah, welcome to the fucking party." He looks around. "You're probably gonna get killed too, I don't give a shit if you're cops."
"One of *us*? You saying we..." There's a dangerous gleam in his eye. "What if I just shot one of your pals here right now, huh?"
"Our colonel did what he had to do. It was either one cunt, or a hundred of them. Ruud here..." He points to him.
"Pops..." he says looking at your saggy sideburns -- they seem to calm him down for a second. "You have no idea about the rights Krenel extends to us."
"Ruud..." The man looks to his left. "Kill him."
"SHUT UP!!! You're not gonna talk yourself out of this, loincloth-shit fuck!"
"Same fucking mudhut town too..." he looks around, then wipes his face with his armoured glove.
"Sergeant Major Raul Kortenaer -- reporting in to burn this fucking mud hut to the ground!" He points at the Whirling-in-Rags...
"She'll be gone soon too. Company bitch is gone, Lely's gone. Fuck are we still doing in this shithole?" He looks around, tired suddenly -- sad even.
"She's fucking GONE!" The shout echoes back from the Whirling windows. "She fucking sailed off! You're *alone*."
"She's gone, you stupid fuck." He points to the sea. "Sailed off -- five minutes ago. She doesn't give a shit about you silos..."
"She's gone, you stupid fuck." He points to the sea. "Sailed off five minutes ago. She doesn't give a shit about you silos. You're *alone*."
"Shush..." He squints at her. "Blood's all gone out now. Not long to go till the rattle starts. One down, girl -- seven to go..."
"Smart loincloth." He stares at you with his watery eyes. "He fucks natives up. Soldier of the Apocalypse-style."
"Stupid shit..." He wipes the sweat from his brow. "I know what you're doing, you *fuck*. It's not gonna work. I'm clear as day."
"That's right." He stares at you with watery eyes. "Plenty of kipts here in Revachol too."
"The bird?" He puts his hand on the gun. "You fucking telling me a bird killed our colonel?"
"The company bitch is gone. Lely's gone. Fuck are we still doing in this shithole?" He looks around, tired suddenly -- sad even.
"The gunner." He gestures toward himself. "The radist." He nods towards the woman. "The killer." He points to the figure clad entirely in ceramic plate.
"The same thing happened when we were called whatever-the-fuck it was. Probably won't be called *Krenel* for much longer either..." He looks around.
"They fucking put Lely in a leaf compactor and now these cunts finished the job..." He waves at the gang huddled by the doors.
"They teach you to shoot the chest in copland? Stupid fuck..." The man shrugs and turns to his left and says: "Kill him."
"Think you can hang our brother and then just fucking *talk* your way out of it?" His eyes flash.
"This... talking-shit won't help you." The man shakes his head and staggers forward.
"Time is up, loincloth," he says to you. "Give me a name. NOW!"
"Told us WHAT?!" He staggers forward. "What did you say? Tattoo-fuck, you'll die NEXT. Right when the she-kipt's out..."
"Told us WHAT?!" He staggers forward. "What did you say? Who said that? Tattoo-fuck -- you'll die FIRST."
"We're gonna tear right through you, I don't give a shit if you're cops."
"What always happens when you get good at your job. That name meant night raids, fucking extra-judicial funkytime... burned villages. Shit that sounds bad on the radio."
"What do you think he *does?*"
"What's that, loincloth? I can't hear you. Sounds like you got your mouth full of dick. Ruud..."
"What's the matter, loincloth? Got your mouth full of dick?" He croaks. "Think I'm gonna spare you?! My brother is dead..."
"What's the matter, loincloth? Mouth full of dick?" He croaks. "Think I'm gonna fucking spare you?!"
"Who the fuck is that?"
"Who... Lely?"
"Yeah, I don't fucking *act* so well. Lely had a hard-on for making faces for you natives. Fucking food-aid shit..." He wipes his mouth. "That shit is done now. Trigger time."
"Yeah, he liked to chat up the natives. Share leaflets, squeeze a bit of kipt ass here and there. Great fucking idea that turned out to be..." He points toward the yard.
"Yeah? Who did then?"
"Yeah? Who the FUCK is Ruby?!" He puts his hand on the gun.
"Yes... So what?"
"You don't *know* shit. Lance Corporal, why don't you.." He turns to the radio officer on this right...
"You don't fucking TALK TO ME about my brother, loincloth!" He squeezes the words out from between clamped lips, his hand on the pistol...
"You got any more *theories* cop?" He turns to you. "We fucking *heard* them -- confess to it. TO YOU!"
"You think I care what that company cunt thinks?" He laughs. It's a hollow laughter.
"You think I'm fucking *stupid*, cop?" There's a dangerous gleam in his eye. "What if I just shoot one of your pals here -- right now, huh?"
"You think I'm fucking *stupid*, cop?" There's a dangerous gleam in his eye. "What if I just shot one of your pals here right now, huh?"
"You think I'm fucking *stupid*..." There's a dangerous gleam in his eye. "What if I just shot one of your pals here right now, huh?"
"You think I'm fucking *stupid*?" There's a dangerous gleam in his eye. "What if I just shot one of your pals here right now, huh?"
"You think this is *funny*?" There's a dangerous gleam in his eye. "What if I just shot one of your pals here for fun, huh?"
"You think you're funny?" There's a dangerous gleam in his eye. "What if I just shot one of your pals here right now, huh?"
"You're *lying*. De Paule heard it." He doesn't move the weapon.
"You're a tit-sucking pig..." He staggers forward: "I'm gonna show you killer."
"You're probably gonna get killed too... I think I'm gonna kill you. I didn't think I had it in me to kill a cop..."
"You're right. But you see..." he pauses and smiles. "I *want* it to end in bloodshed."
"You..." Kortenaer turns his bloodshot eyes to you.
